EmailTemplate.name: Evergreen General Power Red Recruitment
EmailTemplate.subject: Help Boost Power Red Donations
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear [BPL Name],
[Add personal introduction]
Thank you for all that you are doing for patients in need! I so appreciate your efforts to help increase our Power Red collections. Power Red technology at your drive helps reach your blood drive goal by maximizing each person’s donation.
There are two easy ways to help to spread the word and get more Power Red donors!
Educate: Share the “What is a Power Red Donation?” video with potential donors. Ask: Share the benefits of a Power Red donation with your donor base and encourage eligible donors to donate Power Reds instead of whole blood – and use the attached poster at your drives.
Power Red benefits:
Help save more lives: Red blood cells are the most commonly transfused blood component, and therefore the most needed. Maximize your impact: Help more patients with one scheduled appointment! Comfortable experience: A smaller needle is used; you are more hydrated after your donation, and you only have to donate once every 112 days or four months.
In addition to meeting other blood donor qualifications: O- O+ A- B-
General Power Red Qualifications
Female: 5’ 3” Minimum Height, 130 lbs. Minimum Weight Male: 5’ 1” Minimum Height, 150 lbs. Minimum Weight
See current requirements on RedCrossBlood.org.
Please feel free to contact me with any questions. Thank you so much for your continued support of our lifesaving mission!
Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Your Email]
